name: MAS P.L.C.
source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | MAS P.L.C. consolidated annual financial statements for the year to 30 June 2026 (audited, PricewaterhouseCoopers Malta), EUR thousand CRON 20261124: FY2021 column completed from MAS P.L.C. (then MAS Real Estate Inc) audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2021, consolidated statement of profit or loss, and the audited short-form announcement released on SENS 30 August 2021, EUR thousand stored as absolute euro. Printed continuing operations: gross revenue 45,363 (rental income 34,864 plus service charge income and other recoveries 10,499); service charge and other property operating expenses 12,355; corporate expenses 5,700; finance income 15,397; finance costs 9,401; profit before tax 71,434; current tax 180 plus deferred tax 5,443; profit for continuing operations 65,811; profit from discontinued operations 5,931; profit for the year 71,742 all attributable to owners; earnings per share 10.18 euro cents. Same convention as the FY2022 column: Cost of Sales is the service charge and other property operating expenses line, Gross Profit is revenue less that, Operating Expenses is corporate expenses, Operating Profit is gross profit less operating expenses, Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income and is therefore negative here, and Net Profit is the profit for the year including discontinued operations, which is what the stored 10.18 cent EPS is computed on. Ratios computed from these rows and from the FY2021 balance sheet already in this dataset: gross margin 33,008 over 45,363, operating margin 27,308 over 45,363, net margin 71,742 over 45,363, ROE 71,742 over total equity 869,423, ROA 71,742 over total assets 1,326,580.
